name: FBS Flooring
headline:
Expert fitting.
A home that feels
finished.
intro: Flooring consultation, measuring and professional fitting. From your first ideas to the final details, we help you plan your project with confidence.
address: Unit J2, Malahide Road Industrial Estate, Coolock, Dublin 17 · D17 FR58

services.title: Free home consultation
services.summary: Talk through your rooms, get measurements and discuss your plans with a flooring specialist.
services.intro: Start with a visit to your home. FBS works with fitting specialists to assess your space, listen to what you need and help you plan the next step.
steps: Show us the spaces you want to work on and tell us how you use them.
Discuss the floor area, existing surface, access and the details that may affect fitting.
Talk through your preferences, budget and timing before agreeing the work.
services.note: The consultation is free. Fitting and any other agreed work are quoted for your project.

services.title: Professional floor fitting
services.short: The difference is in the details.
services.summary: Discuss the installation, preparation and finishing your space needs, then agree a clear fitting scope.
services.intro: A successful installation begins before the first board is laid. FBS works with skilled fitting specialists to plan and carry out flooring projects for homes and businesses.
steps: Tell us about your flooring, rooms and any existing surface that needs to be considered.
Review the fitting method, preparation, transitions and finishing details required for your project.
Discuss access, room readiness and timing with the team before work starts.
services.note: Please share the exact flooring specification if you already have materials. Suitability, preparation and the installation method need to be reviewed before fitting is agreed.

services.title: New homes & renovations
services.summary: Coordinate the flooring stage around your move, renovation and the other work happening in your home.
services.intro: Moving into a new home or changing the way an existing room feels? FBS’s services include planning and fitting for new-home and renovation projects.
steps: Share the rooms, approximate area and planned handover or renovation dates.
Discuss the existing surface and what other work needs to happen around the fitting stage.
Confirm the project scope and timing with FBS before arranging work.
services.note: A planned move-in date is a useful starting point. Installation dates are agreed with FBS after the space and requirements have been reviewed.

sources.facts: Free home consultations, fitting specialists, home assessment, measurements, tailored advice, new-home projects.
Owner Ilir Sulaj, professional installation, residential and commercial projects.
Public business contact address, telephone and email; no opening hours assumed.
Current business model is services only. No flooring sales, retail catalogue, prices or product ordering.
